sentences.en: It's March 11th, and Major League Baseball's commissioner, Rob Manfred, is sitting at his home in Jupiter, Florida.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月11日，美国职业棒球大联盟的专员罗布·曼弗雷德正坐在他位于佛罗里达州朱庇特的家中。

sentences.en: It's 15 days before what will likely be the most challenging season of his entire time as the sports commissioner.
sentences.zh: 距离他担任体育专员期间可能面临的最具挑战性的赛季还有15天。

sentences.en: He's just been crushed in the press for how he's handled a cheating scandal by the Houston Astros.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚因为如何处理休斯顿太空人队的作弊丑闻而遭到媒体的猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: Interest in the sport is waning, and attendance is down.
sentences.zh: 人们对这项运动的兴趣正在减弱，上座率也在下降。

sentences.en: But that night, at home, in his living room, he can see that the coronavirus is starting to engulf the country.
sentences.zh: 但在那天晚上，在家里的起居室里，他能看到冠状病毒开始吞噬这个国家。

sentences.en: From the beginning of time, nations and people have faced unforeseen challenges, including large-scale and very dangerous health threats.
sentences.zh: 自古以来，国家和人民都曾面对过无法预见的挑战，包括大规模且极度危险的健康威胁。

sentences.en: On his television, Donald Trump is addressing the country from the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 在他的电视机里，唐纳德·特朗普正在椭圆形办公室向全国发表讲话。

sentences.en: And then Manfred stares down at his iPad.
sentences.zh: 然后曼弗雷德低头看着他的 iPad。

sentences.en: Completely uncharted territories.
sentences.zh: 完全未知的领域。

sentences.en: And we are going to get a little more information now from Adrian Wojnarowski, which he is with.
sentences.zh: 现在我们将从阿德里安·沃纳罗斯基那里获得更多信息，他正与……

sentences.en: And he can see that ESPN has just moved a breaking news alert.
sentences.zh: 他可以看到 ESPN 刚刚发布了一条突发新闻提醒。

sentences.en: Right now, the NBA has made the decision.
sentences.zh: 就在刚才，NBA 做出了决定。

sentences.en: They have just announced that they are suspending play.
sentences.zh: 他们刚刚宣布暂停比赛。

sentences.en: That the NBA has suspended its season.
sentences.zh: NBA 已经暂停了他们的赛季。

sentences.en: And Manfred realizes, oh, shit.
sentences.zh: 曼弗雷德意识到，糟糕。

sentences.en: And then the league is going to use that hiatus to decide their next steps, how they'll go forward.
sentences.zh: 然后联盟将利用这段间歇期来决定他们的下一步行动，以及他们将如何继续。

sentences.en: My sport is supposed to begin its season.
sentences.zh: 我的运动本该开始赛季。

sentences.en: And the entire country is shutting down around me.
sentences.zh: 而整个国家却在我周围关闭。

sentences.en: And I have to figure out how to get my sport back on the field amid all this mess.
sentences.zh: 我必须弄清楚如何在这一片混乱中让我的运动重返赛场。

sentences.en: And now, as a player has tested positive for it, the ripple effects that has on his own team, on other teaMs.
sentences.zh: 现在，由于一名球员的检测结果呈阳性，这对他自己的球队以及其他球队都产生了连锁反应。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Mike Schmidt on the fraught weeks that led up to last night's opening game of the 2020 baseball season.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事迈克·施密特将讲述导致昨晚2020年棒球赛季揭幕战的那些令人焦虑的星期。

sentences.en: From the perspective of the commissioner of Major League Baseball.
sentences.zh: 从美国职业棒球大联盟专员的视角来看。

sentences.en: It's Friday, July 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月24日，星期五。

sentences.en: Everybody thinks I've, like, never been to a baseball game.
sentences.zh: 每个人都觉得我好像从来没去过棒球比赛。

sentences.en: No, I was actually told that before we started.
sentences.zh: 不，其实在我们开始之前就有人这么告诉我了。

sentences.en: That's not true.
sentences.zh: 那不是真的。

sentences.en: Drew, I grew up in the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 德鲁，我在美利坚合众国长大的。

sentences.en: They, like, there's, like, a pre-briefing now for you.
sentences.zh: 他们，好像，现在为你准备了一个预先简报。

sentences.en: And they're like, yeah, he's never been to a baseball game.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，哦，他从来没去过棒球比赛。

sentences.en: So let me get this straight.
sentences.zh: 所以让我弄清楚这一点。

sentences.en: Somebody stands in the middle and throws a ball.
sentences.zh: 有人站在中间扔球。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay, we're going to start.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们要开始了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 行吧。

sentences.en: Mike, for the past three years, we have talked to you about the president, Russia, the FBI, national security.
sentences.zh: 迈克，在过去的三年里，我们和你谈论过总统、俄罗斯、联邦调查局、国家安全。

sentences.en: We have not talked to you about baseball.
sentences.zh: 我们没有和你谈论过棒球。

sentences.en: But here we are in this hangout for you to tell us a story about baseball.
sentences.zh: 但此时此刻，你在这个地方给我们讲一个关于棒球的故事。

sentences.en: So just explain that.
sentences.zh: 所以请解释一下这一点。

sentences.en: During the three years covering the Russia investigation, Mueller, whether the president obstructed justice, to understand the story,
sentences.zh: 在报道俄罗斯调查、穆勒、总统是否妨碍司法公正的这三年里，为了理解这个故事，

sentences.en: I focused on the characters who I thought drove it.
sentences.zh: 我把焦点放在我认为推动了这一切的人物身上。

sentences.en: But earlier in my career, in my first beat, when I covered baseball, the Comey and McGahn of that story for my reporting was a little-known labor lawyer named Rob Manfred.
sentences.zh: 但在我职业生涯的早期，在我的第一个报道领域，当我报道棒球时，我那次报道中科米和麦加恩式的人物是一个鲜为人知的劳工律师，名叫罗布·曼弗雷德。

sentences.en: He was the official in the commissioner's office who had to deal with the steroid scandal that was engulfing the sport.
sentences.zh: 他是专员办公室里不得不处理席卷该运动的类固醇丑闻的官员。

sentences.en: Robert Manfred, the executive vice president for labor and human resources at Major League Baseball.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·曼弗雷德，美国职业棒球大联盟劳工与人力资源执行副总裁。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chairman, ranking member, committee members.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，主席先生、资深成员、各位委员会成员。

sentences.en: I especially appreciate the opportunity to speak with you.
sentences.zh: 我特别感谢有机会与你们交谈。

sentences.en: And Manfred and I had a pretty rough start to our relationship.
sentences.zh: 我和曼弗雷德的关系有一个相当艰难的开始。

sentences.en: I was an over-aggressive young reporter.
sentences.zh: 我当时是一个咄咄逼人的年轻记者。

sentences.en: And he was this pugnacious, in-your-face, takes-no-prisoners lawyer who had the sport's biggest problem on his desk.
sentences.zh: 而他是个好斗、强硬、不择手段的律师，手头堆着这项运动最大的难题。

sentences.en: And we would just get on the phone.
sentences.zh: 我们就会通电话。

sentences.en: We'd get on speakerphone.
sentences.zh: 我们用免提通话。

sentences.en: He'd put me on speakerphone.
sentences.zh: 他把我设为免提。

sentences.en: And he would scream at me.
sentences.zh: 他会对我大喊大叫。

sentences.en: And I would push back at him.
sentences.zh: 而我会顶撞他。

sentences.en: And after a while, a few years of this, I think we both sort of looked down at our hands and realized that our hands were sort of bloodied,
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，经过这几年，我想我们俩都低头看了看自己的双手，意识到我们的手有点沾满鲜血，

sentences.en: but we hadn't really got anything out of it.
sentences.zh: 但我们并没有真正从中得到什么。

sentences.en: And we started to build a much more constructive relationship.
sentences.zh: 我们开始建立一种更具建设性的关系。

sentences.en: Did you finally get off speakerphone?
sentences.zh: 你最后终于不用免提了吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Rob's the kind of guy that will put you on speakerphone and tell you what he's really thinking.
sentences.zh: 罗布就是那种会把你开免提然后告诉你他真实想法的人。

sentences.en: Rob is not someone who waxes poetic about baseball.
sentences.zh: 罗布不是那种对棒球满怀诗意赞美的人。

sentences.en: He's someone that ended up working at baseball and is going to do everything in his power to support and defend that sport.
sentences.zh: 他是一个最终在棒球界工作并会竭尽全力支持和捍卫这项运动的人。

sentences.en: So I went on to do other things.
sentences.zh: 所以我去做了别的事情。

sentences.en: And he became the head of the sport.
sentences.zh: 而他成为了这项运动的负责人。

sentences.en: But as the coronavirus was engulfing the country, I said to myself, there's a lot of weighty, really important things going on right now.
sentences.zh: 但当冠状病毒席卷全国时，我对自己说，现在有很多沉重、非常重要的事情正在发生。

sentences.en: But the idea of Rob sitting at home by himself trying to figure out how to save his sports season, how to save the summer, was pretty appealing to me.
sentences.zh: 然而罗布一个人坐在家里试图弄清楚如何拯救他的棒球赛季、如何拯救这个夏天的想法，对我有很大的吸引力。

sentences.en: So I reached out to him and I said, look, you are going to be spending the rest of your career explaining how you dealt with this season.
sentences.zh: 所以我联系了他，我说，听着，你的余生都将用来解释你是如何应对这个赛季的。

sentences.en: And you and your sport both face an existential threat.
sentences.zh: 你和你的运动都面临着生存威胁。

sentences.en: If you don't have a season, your sport's going to lose even more money.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有赛季，你的运动将会损失更多的钱。

sentences.en: It's going to be your legacy.
sentences.zh: 这将是你的遗产。

sentences.en: Let's get on the phone and talk about what that's like.
sentences.zh: 让我们通个电话，聊聊那是什么样的感觉。

sentences.en: Rob?
sentences.zh: 罗布？

sentences.en: Yeah, just give me one second.
sentences.zh: 好的，请给我一秒钟。

sentences.en: And he agreed.
sentences.zh: 他同意了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I got to do this call with Schmidt.
sentences.zh: 我得和施密特打完这个电话。

sentences.en: I'll call you in one minute, OK?
sentences.zh: 我一分钟后打给你，好吗？

sentences.en: So the first time I call him is on May 20th.
sentences.zh: 所以我第一次打电话给他是在5月20日。

sentences.en: All right, Michael, what do you want to talk about this morning?
sentences.zh: 好吧，迈克尔，你今天早上想聊点什么？

sentences.en: He's still at home in Florida.
sentences.zh: 他仍然在佛罗里达的家中。

sentences.en: Like many people working from home, he's taking Zoom calls.
sentences.zh: 就像许多在家办公的人一样，他在接听 Zoom 电话。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I mean, literally what I'm doing is I got a regular series of calls to get back on.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，实际上我在做的是我有一系列常规电话要打回去。

sentences.en: It's clear that he's immersed and knee-deep in the question, how do you take a sport that's normally played in stadiums in front of thousands and thousands of people,
sentences.zh: 很明显，他沉浸其中并深陷于这样一个问题：你如何对待一项通常在体育场里进行、成千上万的人在场观看的运动，

sentences.en: players are right up against each other on the field, and every few days teams, like a traveling roadshow,
sentences.zh: 球员们在球场上紧挨着彼此，每隔几天球队就像巡回演出一样，

sentences.en: go to another city to play another team that's coming from another part of the country?
sentences.zh: 去另一个城市与来自该国另一部分的另一支球队比赛？

sentences.en: So how do you do that in the age of COVID?
sentences.zh: 所以在新冠疫情时代，你该怎么做？

sentences.en: How do we get back to playing?
sentences.zh: 我们如何才能恢复比赛？

sentences.en: One of the things that floated up from one of the experts is, gee whiz, a way that you can do this is to quarantine the players, right?
sentences.zh: 其中一位专家提出的一个想法是，天哪，你可以做到这一点的方法是隔离球员，对吧？

sentences.en: And then he explains to me that there was initially an idea to quarantine all the players in a bubble.
sentences.zh: 然后他向我解释说，最初有一个想法是将所有球员隔离在一个泡泡中。

sentences.en: Essentially, the players would go to a location and be cut off from the rest of society as they played the season.
sentences.zh: 本质上，球员们将去到一个地方，并在他们进行赛季比赛时与社会的其余部分隔绝。

sentences.en: And then you're going to start a four-and-a-half-month season, and your life is going to be hotel to ballpark, back to hotel, room service, not see your family.
sentences.zh: 然后你要开始一个长达四个半月的赛季，你的生活将是酒店到球场，再回到酒店，吃客房送餐，见不到你的家人。

sentences.en: You can't see your families.
sentences.zh: 你不能见你的家人。

sentences.en: You can't be with your families.
sentences.zh: 你不能和你的家人在一起。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, that's one of the – I mean, look, one of the quarantine – so then we realized, gee, that's pretty tough.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，那是其中一个——我的意思是，看，其中一个隔离方案——然后我们意识到，天哪，这太难了。

sentences.en: So then we started talking about including families, and then you realize as you move into that phase that you get into quarantine numbers that are insane.
sentences.zh: 所以我们开始讨论把家人也包括进去，然后当你进入那个阶段时，你会发现你所涉及的隔离人数是疯狂的。

sentences.en: So he says there was another plan, that baseball was essentially going to play in three hubs, Arizona, Texas, and Florida.
sentences.zh: 所以他说还有另一个计划，棒球基本上将在三个中心进行比赛，亚利桑那州、德克萨斯州和佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: Arizona for the West Coast teams, Texas for the Central teams, somewhere in Florida for the East Coast teaMs.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州给西海岸球队，德克萨斯州给中部球队，佛罗里达州的某处给东海岸球队。

sentences.en: That makes sense because those states seem to be more receptive to letting us play.
sentences.zh: 这说得通，因为这些州似乎更容易接受让我们比赛。

sentences.en: The three parts of the country that had not really been hit heavily by the virus.
sentences.zh: 该国受病毒严重打击不大的三个部分。

sentences.en: Not at that point.
sentences.zh: 当时还没有。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: But as they're weighing this plan, the country starts to open up.
sentences.zh: 但正当他们权衡这个计划时，国家开始重新开放。

sentences.en: So baseball again shifts its plan and says, okay, the teams will play in their stadiums, and we will have a game, but it will have many,
sentences.zh: 所以棒球再次改变计划，说，好吧，球队将在他们的球场比赛，我们将有一场比赛，但它会有很多，

sentences.en: many new restrictions that me as a fan and many fans never could have fathomed.
sentences.zh: 许多新的限制，作为球迷的我以及许多球迷从来都无法想象。

sentences.en: What would a game look like now as things are in place based on what you have?
sentences.zh: 在现有情况下，现在的比赛会是什么样子？

sentences.en: What would – you know, the Yankees and the Red Sox are playing tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 会是什么——你知道的，扬基队和红袜队明天要比赛。

sentences.en: What would that look like?
sentences.zh: 那会是什么样子？

sentences.en: Look, it's 67 pages of stuff.
sentences.zh: 听着，那是67页的东西。

sentences.en: I mean, it's really thorough in terms of, you know, what people can – you know, no high fives, no spitting, hand sanitizing in between innings mandatory,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就人们可以——你知道的，不能击掌、不能吐口水、局间必须使用免洗洗手液而言，它真的很彻底，

sentences.en: no exchange of lineup cards at home plate.
sentences.zh: 本垒处不交换阵容卡。

sentences.en: It's done via an app.
sentences.zh: 这是通过一个应用程序完成的。

sentences.en: Players who are not likely to play in the game are outside the dugout in the first couple of rows of the stands.
sentences.zh: 不太可能上场比赛的球员坐在休息区外的看台前几排。

sentences.en: So a pretty different version of baseball than we're used to.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个与我们习惯的相当不同的棒球版本。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全是。

sentences.en: And there's an economic issue.
sentences.zh: 还有一个经济问题。

sentences.en: The owners and the players know that if they return to the field, it will almost certainly be a shorter season and there will be less money to go around.
sentences.zh: 老板和球员们都知道，如果他们重返赛场，几乎可以肯定是缩短的赛季，而且可分配的资金会更少。

sentences.en: And Manfred, as the representative of the owners, thinks that he has an understanding with the players about how that issue will be resolved.
sentences.zh: 而曼弗雷德作为老板的代表，认为他与球员就如何解决这个问题达成了一致。

sentences.en: We advanced them about $170 million a salary, but they agreed in return that they would only get paid their salaries based on a prorated number of games.
sentences.zh: 我们向他们预支了大约1.7亿美元的薪水，但作为回报，他们同意只根据按比例折算的比赛场次来领取薪水。

sentences.en: So it appears like the only thing standing in the way of baseball returning to the field is the virus.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来阻碍棒球重返赛场的唯一因素就是病毒。

sentences.en: And Manfred, as confident as an executive as I've ever had to deal with, sounds confident about this and says, we're going to make this work.
sentences.zh: 而曼弗雷德作为我打过交道的、极其自信的高管，对此听起来信心满满，并表示，我们会让这一切行之有效的。

sentences.en: Hey, Michael, I got a run for today.
sentences.zh: 嘿，迈克尔，我今天得跑了。

sentences.en: I'm happy to pick up the next time.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴下次再聊。

sentences.en: That's fine.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: Let's do that.
sentences.zh: 我们就这么办吧。

sentences.en: That's fine.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.zh: 如果我的记忆没有出错的话，我想确实没有。

sentences.en: I was in a county stadium, and we were going to have to announce that there would be no season.
sentences.zh: 我在科尼斯球场，我们不得不宣布将没有这个赛季。

sentences.en: That night, I came home, and I sat upstairs in the den, and I replayed every World Series from 1945.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，我回到家，坐在楼上的书房里，重温了从1945年以来的每一场世界大赛。

sentences.en: Good afternoon, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家下午好。

sentences.en: This is Don Dunphy speaking for Bill Corum and Bill Slater.
sentences.zh: 我是唐·邓菲，为比尔·科鲁姆和比尔·斯莱特播报。

sentences.en: My first recollection was the Cardinal of St. Louis Browns.
sentences.zh: 我的第一段记忆是关于圣路易斯布朗队的红衣主教。

sentences.en: Here it comes.
sentences.zh: 球来了。

sentences.en: He swings on it, hits it over Marion's head in the left field for a hit.
sentences.zh: 他挥棒击中，把球打过了马里昂的头顶，落入左外野形成安打。

sentences.en: I just sat there very quietly and deep thought.
sentences.zh: 我只是静静地坐在那里，陷入深思。

sentences.en: Man on first, one away.
sentences.zh: 一垒有人，一人出局。

sentences.en: Third baseman, Mark Crispin.
sentences.zh: 三垒手，马克·克里斯平。

sentences.en: He played all men.
sentences.zh: 他防守过所有人。

sentences.en: And I was hurt, sir.
sentences.zh: 而我受伤了，长官。

sentences.en: It's one of the low moments of my career and in my life.
sentences.zh: 这是我职业生涯和人生中低谷的时刻之一。

sentences.en: Because the World War couldn't eliminate the World Series.
sentences.zh: 因为世界大战也无法取消世界大赛。

sentences.en: It was really sad.
sentences.zh: 这真的很让人难过。

sentences.en: When you're sitting there that night in the den, what else is going through your head?
sentences.zh: 那天晚上当你坐在书房里时，脑子里还在想些什么？

sentences.en: Well, one thing I don't think any of us ever really understood was how much it was hurting the sport.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一点我想我们谁也没有真正理解，那就是这对这项运动造成了多大的伤害。

sentences.en: Fans were angry, and we dragged them through the mud.
sentences.zh: 球迷们很愤怒，而我们把他们拖进了泥潭。

sentences.en: I mean, it's now 26 years ago, and the pain, as I sit there and talk to you, comes back to me.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这已经是26年前的事了，而当我坐在这里跟你交谈时，那种痛苦又涌上心头。

sentences.en: And I was worried.
sentences.zh: 我很担心。

sentences.en: Scared me.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到害怕。

sentences.en: How do you feel about a baseball strike?
sentences.zh: 你对棒球罢工怎么看？

sentences.en: Do you think the players are...
sentences.zh: 你觉得球员们是不是……

sentences.en: It would be pretty boring without baseball in the summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天没有棒球会非常无聊。

sentences.en: It just ruins the game.
sentences.zh: 这简直毁了这项运动。

sentences.en: What about the striking?
sentences.zh: 那罢工的事呢？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I think everyone's money hungry.
sentences.zh: 我觉得每个人都对钱眼开。

sentences.en: I wish they'd find an agreement and keep on playing.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们能达成协议继续打球。

sentences.en: Should they play for free?
sentences.zh: 难道他们应该免费打球吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because it's just a game.
sentences.zh: 因为这只是一场游戏。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter how much money you get.
sentences.zh: 拿多少钱根本不重要。

sentences.en: And the owners, they say they don't make enough money.
sentences.zh: 至于老板们，他们说自己赚得还不够。

sentences.en: But the question is, what is enough money?
sentences.zh: 但问题是，多少才算够呢？

sentences.en: So what are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 那你要怎么办？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I guess just watch minor league baseball.
sentences.zh: 我想大概只能看看小联盟棒球了。

sentences.en: I already know what I'm going to start doing.
sentences.zh: 我已经知道我要开始做什么了。

sentences.en: I'm going to start rereading Dante's Inferno, because that's where I think they should send the whole lot of them.
sentences.zh: 我要重新阅读但丁的《地狱》，因为我觉得他们应该把这群人都送到那里去。

sentences.en: So, as you probably suspected, it wasn't just 11-year-old Mike who was mad at baseball.
sentences.zh: 所以，正如你可能猜到的那样，不仅仅是11岁的迈克对棒球感到愤怒。

sentences.en: It was...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: And as bad as 94 was, 95, 96, and 97 were just as bad.
sentences.zh: 而且就像94年一样糟糕，95、96和97年同样糟糕。

sentences.en: Because fans were so upset by the strike that the sport had to rebuild itself and rebuild its credibility with the fans.
sentences.zh: 因为球迷对罢工感到如此沮丧，以至于这项运动不得不重建自身，重建在球迷心中的信誉。

sentences.en: Mike, how much do you think 1994 is on the mind of Manfred?
sentences.zh: 迈克，你觉得1994年对曼弗雷德来说影响有多大？

sentences.en: Enormously.
sentences.zh: 非常巨大。

sentences.en: Huge.
sentences.zh: 极其巨大。

sentences.en: Front of mind.
sentences.zh: 时刻萦绕在脑海中。

sentences.en: And that's when I met him.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时我遇到了他。

sentences.en: And the more I saw Rob, the more I liked him.
sentences.zh: 我越是见到罗伯，就越喜欢他。

sentences.en: And he and I worked well together.
sentences.zh: 我和他合作得很愉快。

sentences.en: Somebody asked me the other day, how often did you talk to Rob back then?
sentences.zh: 前几天有人问我，你当时多久跟罗伯沟通一次？

sentences.en: Maybe 10 times a day, Mike.
sentences.zh: 大概一天10次吧，迈克。

sentences.en: More than he wanted, I may add.
sentences.zh: 我得补充一句，比他想要的还要多。

sentences.en: So, after Manfred became commissioner, Sealy tried to give him some space and some distance.
sentences.zh: 所以，在曼弗雷德成为委员后，西利试图给他一些空间和距离。

sentences.en: He didn't want to look like the father telling the son how to run the sport.
sentences.zh: 他不想看起来像个父亲在教儿子如何管理这项运动。

sentences.en: And a bit of distance grew between the two of them.
sentences.zh: 两人之间产生了一些距离感。

sentences.en: But...
sentences.zh: 但是……

sentences.en: One thing we'll say to each other, Mike.
sentences.zh: 我们俩会互相说的一句话，迈克。

sentences.en: As Manfred found himself in the situation, he began to lean back on Sealy.
sentences.zh: 当曼弗雷德发现自己陷入这种困境时，他开始倚重西利。

sentences.en: I'm the only other guy on the face of the earth that understands exactly what the pressure is and what the situation is.
sentences.zh: 我是地球上唯一一个完全理解这种压力和局势到底是怎么回事的人。

sentences.en: And they talked more than they had at any other point since Manfred had become commissioner.
sentences.zh: 他们之间的交流比曼弗雷德上任以来的任何时候都要多。

sentences.en: Since I've done that job for 22 and a half years.
sentences.zh: 自从我做了22年半这个工作以来。

sentences.en: And yet, and I'm the only one who understands what he's under.
sentences.zh: 然而，我是唯一理解他所承受压力的人。

sentences.en: So, yes, there's no question about that.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这是毫无疑问的。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: Well, great.
sentences.zh: 好的，太棒了。

sentences.en: Well, I hope you enjoyed it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，希望你喜欢。

sentences.en: It was a pleasure to do it.
sentences.zh: 做这个访谈很荣幸。

sentences.en: And we'll talk soon.
sentences.zh: 我们不久后再聊。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So, what happens next in the story, Mike?
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，故事接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: So, at this point, it's been more than a month since my first conversation with Rob.
sentences.zh: 所以，此时距离我第一次和罗伯交谈已经过去了一个多月。

sentences.en: And things are getting really nasty between the owners and the players.
sentences.zh: 老板和球员之间的关系变得非常恶劣。

sentences.en: The middle of June.
sentences.zh: 那是六月中旬。

sentences.en: And boy, what Astros fans would give to be sitting in the stands of Minute Maid Park right about now.
sentences.zh: 天哪，现在太空人队的球迷愿意付出一切只为了能坐在美汁源公园球场的看台上。

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And we were hopeful.
sentences.zh: 我们曾抱有希望。

sentences.en: Baseball negotiations grinding to a halt.
sentences.zh: 棒球谈判陷入停滞。

sentences.en: Like, we're almost to July now.
sentences.zh: 就像我们现在快到七月了一样。

sentences.en: And there's still nothing.
sentences.zh: 却依然毫无进展。

sentences.en: I mean, we're still in the same position that we were in in March.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们依然处于三月份时的老地方。

sentences.en: And if they don't do something about it, the sport is going to fade even more.
sentences.zh: 如果他们再不采取行动，这项运动将会进一步走向消亡。

sentences.en: How are you a commissioner?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能当上委员的？

sentences.en: Like, baseball should have been back a month ago.
sentences.zh: 棒球本该在一个月前就回归的。

sentences.en: They should be basically saying, here's our opportunity to recapture an audience.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上应该说，这是我们重新赢得观众的机会。

sentences.en: It's just, it's unfortunate that it's been so public.
sentences.zh: 只可惜这件事闹得人尽皆知，太不幸了。

sentences.en: I think fans have been turned away a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我想球迷们确实被气得有点疏离了。

sentences.en: There's a reason Major League Baseball's executive office is filled with labor lawyers.
sentences.zh: 美国职棒大联盟的行政办公室里挤满了劳工律师，这是有原因的。

sentences.en: Because they're in a labor fight every 12 years in this league.
sentences.zh: 因为在这个联盟里，他们每12年就要进行一次劳资斗争。

sentences.en: So, Manfred becomes so frustrated that he decides to go out on television and say,
sentences.zh: 因此，曼弗雷德感到如此沮丧，以至于他决定公开上电视表示，

sentences.en: Well, I know the owners are 100% committed to getting baseball back on the field.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我知道老板们100%致力于让棒球重返赛场。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, I can't tell you that I'm 100% certain that's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我无法向你保证这100%会发生。

sentences.en: You know, I said there was going to be a season, but actually, now I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我曾说过会有赛季，但实际上，现在我不敢确定了。

sentences.en: And he's trying any attempt to restart the negotiations, get the players back to the table, and move forward.
sentences.zh: 他正在尝试一切办法来重启谈判，让球员重回谈判桌并向前推进。

sentences.en: That ultimately doesn't really work.
sentences.zh: 这最终并没有真正起作用。

sentences.en: And he has to go out on his own and announces that a 60-game season will start on July 23rd.
sentences.zh: 他只能孤注一掷，宣布7月23日将开启一个60场比赛的赛季。

sentences.en: So, Mike, he can do that, just call a 60-game season without a deal between the players and the owners?
sentences.zh: 等等，迈克，他可以这样做吗？在球员和老板没有达成协议的情况下直接宣布60场比赛的赛季？

sentences.en: It wasn't his first choice.
sentences.zh: 这不是他的首选。

sentences.en: He wanted both sides to buy in.
sentences.zh: 他希望双方都能接受。

sentences.en: He wanted a better deal on how much the players would take a reduction in salary.
sentences.zh: 他希望在球员减薪幅度上达成更好的协议。

sentences.en: But without any other choice and his deep desire to have a season at pretty much any cost, that was his only option.
sentences.zh: 但在别无选择且极度渴望不惜一切代价举办赛季的情况下，这是他唯一的出路。

sentences.en: So, is this seen as a win for the players or for the owners?
sentences.zh: 所以，这被视为球员的胜利还是老板的胜利？

sentences.en: Both and neither.
sentences.zh: 既是也不是。

sentences.en: The players are going to get paid their full salary for the games that they play.
sentences.zh: 球员们将获得他们所打比赛的全部薪水。

sentences.en: Manfred is going to get his season, but neither of them are walking away feeling good about their relationship.
sentences.zh: 曼弗雷德将迎来他的赛季，但双方离开时对彼此的关系都感到很不痛快。

sentences.en: And in the two months that they've taken to resolve this labor issue, they're now back to a health and safety problem.
sentences.zh: 而在他们花了两个月解决这场劳资纠纷之后，他们现在又回到了健康与安全问题上。

sentences.en: Because in that time, COVID has exploded and spread to new states.
sentences.zh: 因为在这段期间，新冠疫情已经爆发并蔓延到了新的州。

sentences.en: And actually, today, as I was preparing to talk to Rob for the final time, news broke that the all-star player on the Nationals, Juan Soto, had tested positive for COVID.
sentences.zh: 事实上，就在今天，当我正准备最后一次与罗伯对话时，有新闻爆出国民队的明星球员胡安·索托新冠检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: So, here's Manfred on the cusp of having the season he fought so hard for, learning just hours before the first pitch that one of the star players may have the virus.
sentences.zh: 因此，曼弗雷德正处于他竭力争取来的赛季即将开打的节骨眼上，却在投出第一球前几小时得知其中一位明星球员可能感染了病毒。

sentences.en: Not ideal.
sentences.zh: 这可真不妙。

sentences.en: Another oh-shit moment in a long season.
sentences.zh: 在这个漫长赛季中又一个“活见鬼”的时刻。

sentences.en: Commissioner?
sentences.zh: 委员？

sentences.en: Hey, Schmidt.
sentences.zh: 嘿，施密特。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Hell of a day.
sentences.zh: 真够折腾的一天。

sentences.en: Hey, well, we're going to make it to the starting line.
sentences.zh: 嘿，不管怎样，我们总算冲过起跑线了。

sentences.en: Everybody seems excited like we've done something.
sentences.zh: 每个人看起来都很兴奋，好像我们已经大功告成了似的。

sentences.en: All we did was get out of the gate, you know?
sentences.zh: 我们其实才刚迈出起步的大门，你知道吗？

sentences.en: The hard part is playing 60 games, you know?
sentences.zh: 难的是打完这60场比赛，你知道吗？

sentences.en: So, anyways, I'm glad we are where we are.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论如何，我很高兴我们能走到今天这一步。

sentences.en: You know, I feel pretty good about it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我对此感觉挺好。

sentences.en: Where are you right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在在哪里？

sentences.en: I'm in Washington.
sentences.zh: 我在华盛顿。

sentences.en: I'm in Nationals Park.
sentences.zh: 我在国民公园球场。

sentences.en: What's the feeling in the air?
sentences.zh: 空气中的气氛怎么样？

sentences.en: You're at opening day with no fans and just the members of the staff.
sentences.zh: 你在开幕日现场，没有球迷，只有工作人员。

sentences.en: What does that feel like?
sentences.zh: 那种感觉是怎样的？

sentences.en: Like, no opening day I've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是我见所未见的开幕日。

sentences.en: I'll tell you that.
sentences.zh: 我跟你说实话。

sentences.en: It's really different, Mike.
sentences.zh: 感觉真的很不一样，迈克。

sentences.en: I mean, it's very stark right now.
sentences.zh: 我是说，现在感觉非常凄清。

sentences.en: It's early still, but it's very stark right now.
sentences.zh: 时间还早，但现在感觉非常凄清。

sentences.en: When you heard today that Juan Soto contracted COVID, we're talking about the all-star on the world championship team, are you like, oh, no, we can't do this?
sentences.zh: 当你今天听到胡安·索托感染新冠的消息时——我们说的是世锦赛冠军球队的明星球员——你当时是不是觉得，哦不，我们没法办下去了？

sentences.en: What's your mindset?
sentences.zh: 你当时的心态是什么样的？

sentences.en: I mean, look, my initial reaction is I can't believe this is happening on opening day.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听着，我的第一反应是难以置信这种事居然会在开幕日发生。

sentences.en: But then I dropped back and I thought about we knew we were going to have positives.
sentences.zh: 但随后我冷静下来，心想我们本来就知道会出现阳性病例。

sentences.en: It's unfortunate that it was opening day and then it was Juan Soto, but the protocols were built to deal with this.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是偏偏是开幕日，而且还是胡安·索托，但我们的防疫规程本来就是为了应对这种情况而制定的。

sentences.en: The whole point is you've got to build a system that's flexible enough to deal with what's coming.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，你必须建立一个足够灵活的系统来应对即将到来的状况。

sentences.en: We knew it was coming.
sentences.zh: 我们早就知道它会来。

sentences.en: I'm mindful that today is July 23rd.
sentences.zh: 我注意到今天是7月23日。

sentences.en: The first time we spoke was May 20th.
sentences.zh: 我们第一次交谈是在5月20日。

sentences.en: It's been two months.
sentences.zh: 已经过去两个月了。

sentences.en: What we've got now is pretty much the plan that you had back then for the virus.
sentences.zh: 我们现在拥有的基本上就是你当时针对病毒制定的计划。

sentences.en: But in this period of time, you went through this whole tumultuous thing.
sentences.zh: 但在这一时期，你经历了整场动荡不安的风波。

sentences.en: If you could go back, would you have done anything differently?
sentences.zh: 如果能回到过去，你会做任何不同的选择吗？

sentences.en: And is there any mistakes you made in the process?
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中你犯过什么错误吗？

sentences.en: Well, if I could go back, I'd love an opportunity to replay that hand.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果能回到过去，我很希望能有机会重新打出这副牌。

sentences.en: And I really would, Michael.
sentences.zh: 我是认真的，迈克尔。

sentences.en: I think that one thing I can certainly point to, the whole from the very beginning, the back and forth in the press and all that.
sentences.zh: 我想我可以肯定指出的一点是，从一开始在媒体上的唇枪舌剑之类的事情。

sentences.en: I just I tried to avoid it.
sentences.zh: 我只是——我曾试图去避免它。

sentences.en: I didn't manage to do it.
sentences.zh: 但我没能做到。

sentences.en: I'd love it to have had a chance to go back and do it over again and be better at it.
sentences.zh: 我很希望能有机会回到过去重新来过，并且能表现得更好。

sentences.en: Do you think there's long term damage from it?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这会带来长期的负面影响吗？

sentences.en: But, you know, I think that I do think it was unsightly and we should we should not have allowed it to happen.
sentences.zh: 但你知道的，我觉得这确实很难看，我们本不该让它发生。

sentences.en: I think we sort of have a debt to our fans.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们对球迷负有一种责任。

sentences.en: Let me ask it this way.
sentences.zh: 让我换个方式问。

sentences.en: The two months of nasty public back and forth negotiations between the owners and the players.
sentences.zh: 老板和球员之间长达两个月令人厌恶的公开拉锯谈判。

sentences.en: Do you think that will have long term damage to the sport going forward, similar to 94?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这会对这项运动未来的发展造成长期损害吗，类似于94年那样？

sentences.en: But I just I can't I just I don't know what to say to that one, Michael.
sentences.zh: 但我就是——我不能——我只是不知道该怎么说，迈克尔。

sentences.en: I just don't know.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道。

sentences.en: So tonight on the field will be exactly what you mapped out.
sentences.zh: 所以今晚场上的一切将完全按照你们规划的那样进行。

sentences.en: The players will be distance.
sentences.zh: 球员们将保持距离。

sentences.en: No high fives.
sentences.zh: 没有击掌。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No spitting.
sentences.zh: 禁止吐口水。

sentences.en: What is your hope for how this game feels to the fans watching at home?
sentences.zh: 你希望在家观看比赛的球迷会有什么感受？

sentences.en: Honestly, I hope that at the end of the night, what fans are thinking is, you know what?
sentences.zh: 老实说，我希望在今晚结束时，球迷们心里想的是，你知道吗？

sentences.en: It's not everything that we're used to and love about the game.
sentences.zh: 这虽然不是我们所习惯并热爱的全部比赛内容。

sentences.en: But you know what?
sentences.zh: 但你知道吗？

sentences.en: It's great to have baseball.
sentences.zh: 能有棒球看真好。

sentences.en: And an empty stadium and no acknowledgement from the fans and no acknowledgement to the fans.
sentences.zh: 空荡荡的球场，没有对球迷的致意，也没有球迷的呼应。

sentences.en: We're done.
sentences.zh: 我们完成了。

sentences.en: OK, thanks, man.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢，伙计。

sentences.en: I'll talk to you soon.
sentences.zh: 我们回头聊。

sentences.en: We get a real good feel for tonight.
sentences.zh: 我们对今晚有了很好的直观感受。

sentences.en: And now one of the more well-known Washington National fans, Dr. Anthony Fauci, to throw out the first pitch.
sentences.zh: 现在请华盛顿国民队的知名球迷之一，安东尼·福奇博士来为比赛开球。

sentences.en: So, Mike, I am talking to you at 930 p.m.
sentences.zh: 所以，迈克尔，我现在是在晚上9点30分跟你通话。

sentences.en: on Thursday evening.
sentences.zh: 在周四的晚上。

sentences.en: The game is currently underway.
sentences.zh: 比赛正在进行中。

sentences.en: The first pitch was thrown out by Dr. Anthony Fauci, and it was pretty wobbly.
sentences.zh: 第一球是由安东尼·福奇博士投出的，而且投得有点歪歪扭扭。

sentences.en: I assume you've been watching the game.
sentences.zh: 我想你一直在看比赛吧。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we're now in the middle of a rain delay.
sentences.zh: 我们现在正处于因雨暂停的中场休息阶段。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Which is perhaps why you're talking to me.
sentences.zh: 这大概就是你为什么在跟我说话。

sentences.en: I know you didn't set out to be philosophical about baseball with this assignment.
sentences.zh: 我知道你这次采访并不是冲着探讨棒球哲学来的。

sentences.en: But if we could get philosophical for just a moment, I wonder how you're thinking about baseball and this game right now.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们能借此机会稍微探讨一下哲学，我想知道你现在是如何看待棒球和这场比赛的。

sentences.en: Look, I told you about my first realization when I was 11 years old that baseball walks a fine line between being a game and a business.
sentences.zh: 听着，我跟你说过我11岁时的初次领悟，当时我意识到棒球在运动和商业之间走了一条微妙的钢丝。

sentences.en: When I became a sports reporter, I covered the darkest underbelly of the sport and saw it in probably a nastier light than most fans could ever dream of.
sentences.zh: 当我成为一名体育记者时，我报道过这项运动最黑暗、最不可告人的一面，并且看到它时所呈现的丑陋面貌，可能远超大多数球迷所能想象的。

sentences.en: And in the years after that, I had a hard time falling back into the romantic fandom of baseball.
sentences.zh: 在那之后的几年里，我很难再重新找回对棒球那种浪漫的球迷情怀。

sentences.en: I had just seen too much.
sentences.zh: 我只是见识过太多了。

sentences.en: But last year, almost a decade after I left sports, I got my fandom back.
sentences.zh: 但在去年，也就是我离开体育界差不多十年后，我又找回了球迷的心态。

sentences.en: I caught the bug again.
sentences.zh: 我又重新着迷了。

sentences.en: And as 2020 started, I was ready to continue that and to try and be that fan again.
sentences.zh: 随着2020年的开始，我准备延续这种状态，努力再次成为那样一个球迷。

sentences.en: These negotiations brought back those feelings of the two-headed monster of baseball and the business head becoming too big.
sentences.zh: 这些谈判重新唤起了那种感觉：棒球这个双头怪兽中，商业的那一个脑袋变得太大了。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, there's going to be a season and it's going to look weird and feel very, very different.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，赛季终究会开启，它看起来会很诡异，感觉也会非常非常不同。

sentences.en: But it's a season and it's baseball.
sentences.zh: 但它毕竟是个赛季，而且这就是棒球。

sentences.en: In other words, you're still a little bit of a romantic.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，你骨子里还是个浪漫主义者。

sentences.en: Look, I'll take it.
sentences.zh: 听着，我认了。

sentences.en: I'll take it for now.
sentences.zh: 目前我先接受这样。

sentences.en: Mike, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Enjoy the game.
sentences.zh: 享受比赛吧。

sentences.en: Enjoy the season.
sentences.zh: 享受这个赛季吧。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: That ball is high in the air to left center.
sentences.zh: 那球高高飞向左中外野。

sentences.en: That ball is high.
sentences.zh: 那球飞得很高。

sentences.en: It is far.
sentences.zh: 飞得很远。

sentences.en: It is gone.
sentences.zh: 出去了。

sentences.en: Oh, way back in the left center field seats.
sentences.zh: 噢，落在了左中外野观众席的深处。

sentences.en: Had there been fans in the ballpark, it was a guy that bought the worst seat that would have gotten that souvenir.
sentences.zh: 如果球场里有球迷的话，买到最差座位的那个家伙就能拿到这个纪念品了。

sentences.en: Oh, what a shot by Stanton.
sentences.zh: 噢，斯坦顿这一击太漂亮了。

sentences.en: It's a two-run dinger.
sentences.zh: 这是一记两分本垒打。

sentences.en: And the Yankees immediately take a two-nothing lead.
sentences.zh: 洋基队迅速取得了二比零的领先。

sentences.en: He turned around a 96-mile-an-hour fastball, 459 feet.
sentences.zh: 他轰出了一记时速96英里的速球，飞行距离达到459英尺。

sentences.en: What's the saying we always have?
sentences.zh: 我们常说的那句话是什么来着？

sentences.en: The harder it comes in, the harder it goes out.
sentences.zh: 球速越快，飞得越远。

sentences.en: And that's the MVP swing that the New York Yankees acquired from the Marlins.
sentences.zh: 这就是纽约洋基队从马林鱼队那里得到的MVP级别的挥棒。

sentences.en: As the old line goes, that ball went so far, they should serve a meal on it.
sentences.zh: 正如老话所说，那一球飞得太远了，都够在上面吃一顿饭了。

sentences.en: So the Yankees take a two-nothing lead.
sentences.zh: 于是洋基队取得了二比零的领先。

sentences.en: That was Stanton's 21st career.
sentences.zh: 这是斯坦顿职业生涯的第21支。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 以下是你结束这一天所需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.zh: 周四，美国在疫情中达到了一个新的里程碑，已知感染人数达到400万。

sentences.zh: 成千上万的人想要亲临现场。

sentences.en: To avoid strict social distancing rules, the president had moved the events from North Carolina to Florida, which now has the highest infection rate in the country.

sentences.zh: 但我看着我的团队说，这次活动的时机不对。

sentences.zh: 结合最近发生的事情以及佛罗里达州的疫情爆发，时机实在不对。
